raw_response: {"diagnosis": "A subset of raw_customers rows store region as numeric codes ('01'-'04') instead of names, and silver_customers passes them through unchanged. raw_region_map supplies the code-to-name mapping (01 WEST, 02 EAST, 03 NORTH, 04 SOUTH), so joining it in silver_customers normalizes the domain, and the gold_region_daily step then reads the corrected values.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_customers": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, COALESCE(m.region_name, upper(c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON m.region_code = c.region;"}}
